description_en: Verifies existing baseline risks. If the verification passes, the status of the risk items is updated to passed
description_zh: 验证操作是对存在的基线问题进行验证，如果验证通过，风险项状态将更新为已通过
name: ValidateHcWarnings

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the risk items to verify. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can call the [DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行验证操作的风险项ID列表。如果有多个风险项ID，使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用[DescribeCheckWarnings](~~DescribeCheckWarnings~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: risk_ids

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers to verify. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain server UUIDs
parameters.help_zh:
要验证的服务器的UUID。多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the check items. Separate multiple check item IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116179.html operation to obtain check item IDs
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。多个检查项ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116179.html接口获取检查项ID
parameters.name: check_ids

parameters.help_en:
The status of the check item to verify. Valid values:

1: not passed
3: passed
5: expired
parameters.help_zh:
验证的检查项状态。

1：未通过

3：已通过

5：已失效
parameters.name: status

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
